summary: Frontend-only verification of iteration_59 fixes, the premium All India card, the 2x2 practice grid, the Rank tab placeholder and the tablet player layout. Logged in once with the approved account (7004186276), reused localStorage and aborted every non-GET /api/jl/** and /api/rf/** request, so nothing academic or RF was written. All requested items PASS. Home at 390/320: the series card is an onyx-to-ruby gradient with an 'ALL INDIA SERIES' chip ('ALL INDIA' at 320), '62 DAYS', a ring 78px (66 at 320), a 3-column facts strip, a date line that reads '1 Dec – 31 Jan · one a day' at 320 with no truncation, a 100% AI ribbon and a red CTA. No overflow or clipping was detected in the banner, facts, grid or promo. The practice grid is 2x2 with tiles 173x168 (138x150 at 320), no horizontal scroll, and all 4 tiles route correctly. The promo hides '200+' at 320 and shows it at 390. The promo CTA is 44px tall and opens /live. For You badges are 9.5px. The watermark is aria-hidden. Tab bar: HOME, RANK, RAPID FIRE, MY TESTS, MISSION at 10.5px (10px at 320), with no overflow. tab-jee is gone and the JEE hub is still reachable from the Home tile. The Rank screen has no rank numbers; rank-open-series opens /live and rank-open-results opens /tests?tab=completed with the Completed tab selected. /pyq subtitle is #8E8E97 and back without history goes to /exam/jee-main. /live: the skipped icon is #7A4A3C on #FBEFF1 and the lock icons are #6B6B75. Set detail at 320: the eyebrow wraps to 2 lines and the TEJAS200/Owner-supplied line is gone. Chapter-wise: the Physics chip is black, rings are grey/ink, there is 14px between the chips and the count, and the search has no outline. History and My Tests: negative scores are red (#DC2626), positive green, 'Preparing result' amber (#B45309). My Tests has a chip divider, both selected chips are black and the search has no outline. Solutions: the active subject tab is black with white text. Player via route-intercepted fixture 'fx-tablet' (no submit called): at 390 the phone layout and palette sheet work and the selected option is black. At 820x1180 the top bar, progress, segment and dock are centred at 760. At 1194x834 and 1366x1024 player-side-panel is 360px wide, the palette button is hidden, the dock covers only the left pane, side-q-3/side-q-4 jump correctly, and the integer input with a value gets a black border. Splash backgroundColor is #FFFFFF and the wordmark is dark. Regression: Rapid Fire stays dark and Home returns to light. No page errors or red screens. tsc --noEmit is clean. RF source files were last modified before iteration_59, so they were not touched this round.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Answered & marked' legend label is truncated to 'Answered & mark...' inside the 360px side panel at 1194 and 1366 widths. The phone palette sheet shows the full label. Shorten the label, use a single-column legend in the side panel, or allow wrapping.

issues: The 11px 'ALL INDIA RANK' eyebrow uses custom_eyebrow #8E8E97 on white, which is about 3.3:1. That passes the 3:1 target but is below 4.5:1 for small text. Optional: darken eyebrows to about #6B6B75.
Zero scores ('0 / 200 marks') are shown in success green. Consider neutral ink for 0 so only positive scores are green.

action_items: Low: fix the truncated 'Answered & marked' legend label in player-side-panel at wide widths.
Optional: show a zero score in neutral colour instead of green; consider darker eyebrow ink for 11px labels.
critical_code_review_comments: Opening the Solutions tab fires POST /questions/<id>/solution-open (aborted in this test). Confirm it is intended analytics and fails silently.

In the wide player layout the top bar and subject segment span the full width, including over the side panel, while the reading column is centred in the left pane. This is acceptable, but a future polish could align the top bar to the left pane.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks pass (1 low-priority truncation, 2 optional design notes)

seed_data_creation: None. Player data was a browser-only route-intercepted fixture 'fx-tablet'. No records were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Log in once via entry-phone-input / entry-pin-input / entry-continue-button and save localStorage jl_sid/jl_user to /tmp/jl_ls.json, then inject it with add_init_script. Abort non-GET /api/jl/** and /api/rf/** (RF then shows 'Failed to fetch', a test artifact). Player fixture: see /app/tests/iter60_player_tablet_fixture_snippet.py; register the generic guard first, then **/attempts/fx-tablet** (Playwright gives the later route priority). side-q-* only lists the current subject's questions, so switch with player-subject-<subject> first.
